claims.population: The Gusau Local Government Area has a population of 383,162 as of the 2006 census.
claims.economy: Gusau town has attracted attention as an important agricultural and commercial center.
claims.crafts: In the area there were builders, thatchers, butchers, blacksmiths, drummers, praise-singers, etc.
claims.climate: Gusau has a tropical savanna climate (Köppen climate classification Aw).
claims.see-also: See also: Gusau Dam, Gusau Airstrip, Railway stations in Nigeria, Federal Medical Centre, Gusau.
